criterion: RUNS FIRST AND GATES EVERYTHING. Before any model forward, the exact turn strings are tokenized per member and three things are checked. (1) EQUALITY: under the wide rule every sighting of a session covers the same number of positions, in every cell and every session. (2) WIDTH: that number equals the legacy rule's LATER-TURN width for the same session, exactly -- computed in this run, not quoted -- and it is also reported against the strength pilot run recorded widths (23 / 18 / 22 / 22 / 11 / 18 / 18 tokens for OLMo-2-32B, Qwen2.5-32B, Qwen3-14B, Qwen3-32B, Mistral-24B, Gemma-3-27B, Llama-3.1-8B) as an independent cross-check. (3) DELIVERED TOTAL: all four constant-total cells deliver the same summed magnitude, gate 3 percent, in all seven members. A failure means the priming turn did not do what the render path implies, and the run stops and reports rather than proceeding.
the_widening:
One change: a single fixed, bland, non-experiential priming exchange is placed at the front of every conversation, so no zone sighting is ever the first turn. Every sighting is then rendered by the same later-turn path and injected across the whole of that turn's rendered delta -- byte-for-byte the rule the strength pilot run applied to its turns 1-5. Widths are equal across sightings BY CONSTRUCTION (each covers the previous turn's close, this turn's user-open, the zone line, and the generation prompt) AND return to the strength pilot run later-turn values, which stage 1 checks exactly, session by session, against the legacy rule measured in this same run.
The priming exchange is identical in every cell and for both zone roles, is never injected, and its assistant side is teacher-forced rather than sampled, so the token stream stays deterministic and it cannot favour a zone. What it does change is the token stream itself, so byte-identity with the strength pilot run and the narrow-span pilot run is GIVEN UP for the panel cells; within-run identity across cells that share an exposure count is asserted per session instead, and the two diagnostic cells carry no priming, so they are byte-identical to the narrow-span pilot run and the strength pilot run cells and are checked against those runs' recorded ids. No panel cell's effect size is comparable to the narrow-span pilot run cell-for-cell, and none is compared: every comparison that carries a verdict is between cells built and read the same way inside this run.
